task_description: How many default paths are looked for when I execute an executable on this computer? (Only existing and valid directories)

args.script:
count=0
for dir in $(echo $PATH | tr ':' ' '); do
  if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ -x "$dir" ]; then
    count=$((count+1))
  fi
done
echo "PATH=$PATH"
echo "Count: $count"
